notes:
The server stays at 0.3.2 — only the app changed.

**New**
- D&D 5e template: Story note — clues, handouts, diaries, letters, prophecies: what the story leaves to be read. Kind, written by, found in which session and where; sessions list theirs, quests their clues.
- A date is set with or without a time, in the visual editor too.
- A document is renamed in the visual editor too: its name stands in the side bar beside access and alias.

**Fixed**
- Pasting into a text works on Windows and Android — nothing was put in.
- Every page one goes to shows the world as it is now, whoever changed it and wherever.
- A world on a server is listed as its server tells it before it is opened — not as a player's with nothing in it.
- A side column fits the window, so a short page no longer scrolls for it.
- A document made just now can be left for reading again; the add menus open over the page.
